# Run the analysis

::: {.callout-warning}
This section is a preparation scaffold. No verified dataset or case-study interpretation is supplied. Complete the provenance notes in `data/hypertension/README.md` before running.
:::

Run from the main project folder:

```bash
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/hypertension --output-dir results/hypertension
```

Review the figures and saved tables. The analysis is descriptive; functional profiles represent relative potential, not activity.
